story:
Ethan walked into the sunny community park, his backpack jingling softly. [emotion:QT/excited] He felt excited because he planned to dig up the special "dinosaur bone" he had buried last week near the big oak tree. As he headed towards his secret spot, he noticed a new boy, Leo, trying to build a very tall tower of colorful blocks. [emotion:QT/sad] Leo looked frustrated, his brow furrowed, as the blocks kept toppling over with a clatter.

[emotion:QT/shy] Ethan felt a little nervous about talking to someone he didn’t know, but he also felt kind because [emotion:QT/afraid] Leo looked so worried. He watched Leo try again, placing a small, red block on top of a wobbly blue one. *Crash!* The tower fell apart again. [gesture:think] Ethan thought carefully, then walked closer. "Your tower keeps falling," he observed gently. "Maybe the base is too narrow?" Leo looked up, [emotion:QT/surprised] then nodded slowly. "I want it to be *magnificent*," Leo said, "but it always falls!"

[emotion:QT/happy] "We could try building it together," Ethan suggested, feeling brave. "I think the bottom needs wider blocks so that it can be strong." Leo picked up a large, flat green block. "Like this one?" he asked. [emotion:QT/happy] "Exactly!" Ethan said. "Let's put this wide, green block *underneath* first." They started working, taking turns placing blocks. Ethan was very *observant*, pointing out a tiny crack on an *intricate* yellow block. "That one might be wobbly," he said, "so we should use a different one." They showed great *collaboration*, discussing each step. Soon, a tall, sturdy tower stood proudly. [emotion:QT/happy] Both boys beamed with relief. "It's magnificent!" Leo exclaimed. "Thank you for helping me, Ethan!"

[emotion:QT/happy] "You're welcome!" Ethan replied, feeling very proud. "We made a great team." Then he remembered his own plan. "Hey, I buried a pretend dinosaur bone over by that big oak tree. Do you want to come help me dig it up? We can be paleontologists!" [emotion:QT/excited] Leo's eyes lit up. "Yes! That sounds like fun!" They ran off, ready for their next adventure together.
